event.title: Abdelmadjid Tebboune Wildfire
event.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has proposed reinstating the death penalty for individuals who deliberately set forest fires. This decision follows a series of wildfires that resulted in the deaths of 12 people and left dozens injured. Currently, 46 fires are still active, with many victims hospitalized, including some in critical condition.

timeline.title: Algeria Considers Death Penalty for Arson Following Deadly Wildfires
timeline.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has proposed reinstating the death penalty for individuals found guilty of deliberately setting forest fires. This decision follows a series of wildfires that resulted in the deaths of 12 people and injuries to dozens more. Currently, 46 fires are still active across several eastern provinces, with many victims hospitalized, some in critical condition.
